programs.title: Land and Sea
programs.desc: A schooner once owned by Arctic explorer, Captain Bob Bartlett returned to Brigus, N.L., this summer; we meet some of the people with past and present connections to this treasured vessel.

programs.title: Still Standing
programs.desc: The forced relocation of the Membertou First Nation 100 years ago sent the community into crisis; thanks to a bold economic plan, they have successfully pulled off a stunning transformation.

programs.title: Travel Man: 48 Hours in...
programs.desc: Richard is joined by Lou Sanders for a blast around Bergen, Norway; they go on a gastronomic adventure, view odd architecture, ride a cable car to the top of Mt. Ulriken and fly down the fastest zip-line in Norway.

programs.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
programs.desc: All is well at Mossy Bottom Farm, except for the fact that the animals will do anything to get out of work. So, Shaun the sheep and his scheming friends devise a plan to put their master to sleep. However, the ruse backfires when the poor farmer finds himself transported to the big city, having lost his memory. Now, it's up to Sean, Timmy the lamb, Shirley the ewe and the rest of the gang to travel to the metropolis and get him back, while not landing in even more trouble themselves.

programs.title: Jamie's Super Food Family Classics
programs.desc: Jamie goes to Switzerland and South Korea. He cooks magic poached egg with smoked salmon, chocolate porridge and super green cannelloni.

programs.title: The Great Canadian Pottery Throw Down
programs.desc: It's raku week and the potters are all fired up.
